title: jitso arsenal --all adds the skills and MCP servers no allowlist names, each marked with the file to edit, and a line for the claude.ai connectors
source: intended: JITSO v0.2 plan 2.5 (--all: folders under .agents/skills and ~/.claude/skills, servers of .mcp.json and ~/.claude.json)
intent: A folder under ~/.claude/skills without a SKILL.md is not a skill. Cloud connectors cannot be listed by JITSO; a launched session cannot get them in v0.2.

files..agents/skills/sprint-testing/SKILL.md:
---
name: sprint-testing
description: >
  Runs in-sprint manual QA per issue: plan, execute and report. Use when testing a user story.
---
files..agents/skills/unlisted-skill/SKILL.md:
---
name: unlisted-skill
description: A project skill the allowlist does not name.
---
